reasoning_content:
The minimal mapfile using common.txt is failing on line 27's MAXSIZE ${XPLAN_SERVICES_WMS_MAXWIDTH}. But env is set. In MapServer 7.6, ${VAR} substitution inside a mapfile... hmm, MapServer's mapfile substitution should handle ${VAR}. Let me test:

MAP
  MAXSIZE ${XPLAN_SERVICES_WMS_MAXWIDTH}
END

Actually — MapServer's mapfile environment variable substitution is done at load time, but maybe there's an issue with the MAP object's MAXSIZE. Let me do a binary search. Also the "near ($)" error — could it be that ${XPLAN_SERVICES_WMS_MAXWIDTH} isn't getting substituted and the $ is being read in as a literal? In MapServer's mapfile syntax, ${VAR} gets substituted from the process environment. Let me test a simple case.

action.command:
export TESTVAR=4096
cat > /tmp/m2.map <<'EOF'
MAP
  NAME "test"
  MAXSIZE ${TESTVAR}
  STATUS ON
  EXTENT 0 0 10 10
END
EOF
QUERY_STRING="map=/tmp/m2.map&request=GetCapabilities&service=WMS" REQUEST_METHOD=GET SERVER_PROTOCOL="HTTP/1.1" HTTP_HOST=localhost REMOTE_ADDR=127.0.0.1 timeout 20 mapserv 2>&1 | sed 's/<[^>]*>//g' | grep -vE "^\s*$" | head -4
echo "=== now without env var ==="
unset TESTVAR
QUERY_STRING="map=/tmp/m2.map&request=GetCapabilities&service=WMS" REQUEST_METHOD=GET SERVER_PROTOCOL="HTTP/1.1" HTTP_HOST=localhost REMOTE_ADDR=127.0.0.1 timeout 20 mapserv 2>&1 | sed 's/<[^>]*>//g' | grep -vE "^\s*$" | head -3
